name: MeTube
description_en: Web GUI for youtube-dl, with playlist support. Allows downloading videos from dozens of websites. `AGPL-3.0` `Python/Nodejs/Docker`
description: Self-hosted video downloader for YouTube and other sites (web UI for yt-dlp)
readme_preview:
![Build Status](https://github.com/alexta69/metube/actions/workflows/main.yml/badge.svg) ![Docker Pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/alexta69/metube.svg)

MeTube is a self-hosted web UI for `yt-dlp`, for downloading media from YouTube and [dozens of other sites](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/supportedsites.md).

Key capabilities: * Download videos, audio, captions, and thumbnails from a browser UI. * Download playlists and channels, with configurable output and download...
